name: Velvet Drape
description: Plush, heavy-weight velvet with a rich sheen. Blocks light beautifully and drapes in soft, luxurious folds.

name: Linen Sheer
description: Breathable, airy sheer linen. Filters daylight softly — perfect for living rooms and layered curtain looks.

name: Ankara Print
description: Vibrant wax-print Ankara with bold traditional patterns. Adds character to cushions, blinds and accent drapes.

name: Silk Taffeta
description: Fine, lustrous taffeta with a crisp finish. Holds structure elegantly — ideal for formal swags and pelmet styling.

name: Blackout Champagne
description: Premium 3-pass blackout fabric in a warm champagne tone. Total privacy, thermal insulation, hotel-grade quality.

name: Brocade Gold
description: Woven jacquard brocade with subtle gold thread. Statement fabric for luxury drapes and upholstery accents.
